title: DTIC ADA264825: Laser Based 3D Volumetric Display System
abstract: In the past several years, the Display Systems Branch, Naval Ocean Systems Center (NOSC), has been involved in the development of laser based display systems with the goal of upgrading the image quality of shipboard displays. In the paper we report work on: (1) developing laser generated 3D volumetric images on a rotating double helix, (where the 3D displays are computer controlled for group viewing with the naked eye), and (2) system feasibility results along with the first and second generation component parameters.
